title: Shield Potion (Fortnite)
blurb: The Fortnite shield potion glug — the gulping sound of drinking blue liquid while being shot at. It's one of the most recognisable sounds in modern gaming, and it doubles as the internet's audio for chugging anything. Play it while drinking, before entering a difficult conversation, or any time you need fifty extra shield.
origin: The shield-potion drinking sound from Fortnite.
